neighbours.label: the end, suspension or lapse of a policy or programme (lapses, suspended, debt relief)
fire: The trade agreement lapses at the end of the year unless parliament renews it.
All of the country's nuclear reactors have been gradually suspended.
Poor nations applied for debt relief under the new international program.
The subsidy expires next spring, and no one expects it to be renewed.
The ceasefire was suspended after both sides reported new attacks.
The tax break will lapse in December if Congress does not act.
The grant program was halted while auditors reviewed the spending.
The license was revoked after the company missed three deadlines.
quiet: The trade agreement covers cars, steel and farm products from both countries.
All of the country's nuclear reactors are located near the coast.
Poor nations applied for loans under the new international program.
The subsidy pays farmers a fixed amount for each acre they plant.
The ceasefire talks were held in a hotel near the border.
The tax break helps families with young children pay for daycare.
The grant program funds small libraries in rural areas.
The license lets the company sell its products in four states.

notes: card: weak, mixed top examples around treaties, debt relief, suspended reactors
